app.title: Termin: the earliest NFZ specialist appointment
app.tagline: The earliest publicly funded (NFZ) specialist appointments in Poland: where, how far, and which number to call.
app.hero_lead: Enter a specialist and a town. We will show the date, the distance and the number worth calling.

form.gps_error: Could not get your location. Please type a city or postcode.
form.km_per_day: For each day sooner I am willing to travel further by:
form.km_per_day_hint: Example: at 2 km, an appointment two weeks sooner is worth a 28 km longer trip.
form.required: Type what you are looking for and where you are.

results.found: Found {n} facilities. The best match is first.
results.none: No appointments found in this area. Try a larger distance or a different service.
results.heading: Results: {label}
results.offline: You are offline. Showing the last saved results from {date}.
results.error: Something went wrong. Please try again in a moment.
results.map_label: Map of facilities in the results. The same information is in the list below.

card.script: What to say on the phone
card.forecast_sr: NFZ forecast: about {pcus} wait, roughly until {date}. This is not a free slot.

reasons.best_balance: best balance between date and distance
reasons.faster_than_median: {days} {days_word} sooner than typical in the province
reasons.slower_than_median: {days} {days_word} later than typical in the province

alerts.no_date: the facility did not report a date, call and ask
alerts.past_date: the reported date ({date}) has passed, so the data is outdated
alerts.no_phone: no phone number in NFZ data
alerts.forecast: this is an NFZ forecast ({pcus}), not a free slot: call and ask for the earliest date
alerts.empty_queue: nobody is waiting in this queue, so a 0-day forecast may mean the queue is inactive
alerts.cer: booking via Central e-Registration: the Patient's Internet Account (IKP), the mojeIKP app or by phone
alerts.approx_location: NFZ gave no map position, so the distance is to the municipality centre (approximate)

script.hello: Hello, I have a referral to: {benefit}{urgent}. I would like the earliest available appointment.
script.check: The NFZ search shows {date}. Is it still available? If not, what is the earliest possible date?
script.check_nodate: What is the earliest available date?
script.earlier: Can you let me know if an earlier slot becomes available?
script.referral: By when and how should I deliver the referral?
script.item_referral: the referral or the e-referral code (4 digits) and PESEL
script.item_pesel: the patient's PESEL number (for a child: the child's PESEL)
script.item_docs: medical records and test results they may ask about
script.item_pen: a calendar and pen to note the date and time
script.note: Facilities update their data about once a week, so the date shown may differ from reality.
script.check_forecast: Can I book the earliest available date? (NFZ forecasts about {pcus} of waiting.)

watch.title: Watch: {label}
watch.intro: Get notified when an earlier date appears in this area. No account needed.
watch.target_ntfy_hint: Pick a hard-to-guess name and subscribe to it in the ntfy app. The topic works like a password.
watch.ok: Done! You are watching: {label}. Link to stop: {url}
watch.privacy: We only store what you enter here. Location is rounded to about 1 km. See the privacy policy.
watch.ok_push: Done! Watching: {label}. You'll get a phone notification. Remove it in Account or here: {url}

share.copied: Link copied. You can paste it into a text message.

history.title: Earliest date over time
history.empty: Not enough history for this facility yet. History builds up from searches.
history.unknown: Not enough data to judge the trend.
history.chart_label: Chart of waiting time in days

stats.title: Waiting time: {label}, {province} province
stats.summary: Median: {median} days. Half of facilities offer a date within {p25}–{p75} days, 90% within {p90} days. Facilities with a date: {n}.

footer.disclaimer: Termin is not an official NFZ app and does not give medical advice. We show data from the public NFZ “Terminy leczenia” API, which facilities update about once a week. Always confirm by phone.

install.title: Install Termin
install.intro: Termin works like a regular app: an icon on your screen, its own window and access without internet. No app store needed.
install.ios_1: Tap the Share button (a square with an arrow).
install.android_1: Open the menu (three dots in the top right corner).
install.android_2: Choose “Install app” or “Add to Home screen”.
install.desktop_1: Click the install icon at the end of the address bar, or choose “Install Termin” in the menu.
install.done: Termin is installed. You will find it among your apps.

auth.terms_age: I am at least 16 years old.
auth.optional: An account is optional: search and watching also work without logging in.
auth.forgot_intro: Enter your account e-mail. We will send a link to set a new password.
auth.password_rules: At least 10 characters. A few easy-to-remember words work best.
auth.terms_required: Please accept the terms to create an account.
auth.registered: Account created. Check your e-mail to confirm your address.
auth.remember: Keep me signed in on this device
auth.code_mfa: Code from the app or a recovery code
auth.code_mfa_hint: 6 digits from your authenticator app. No phone? Use one of your recovery codes.
auth.recover_intro: Enter one of the recovery codes you saved when creating the account and choose a new password.
auth.mfa_intro: Open the authenticator app on your phone and enter the code for Termin.
auth.password_saved_mfa: New password saved. Now enter your second factor.
auth.registered_nomail: Account created. Save your recovery codes: they are the only way back in if you forget your password.
auth.codes_low: Signed in. Only {n} recovery codes left: generate new ones in account settings.
auth.password_reset_done: New password saved. You are signed in; other devices were signed out.

account.title: Your account
account.delete_warning: We will delete your account and all your watches. This cannot be undone.
account.unverified: Your e-mail address is not confirmed yet.
account.no_subscriptions: You are not watching anything. Search and click “Watch”.
account.password_changed: Password changed. Other devices were logged out.
account.deleted: Your account and all data were deleted.
account.twofa_intro: When signing in you will enter, besides your password, a 6-digit code from an app on your phone (e.g. Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, 2FAS or Aegis). Even if someone learns your password, they can't sign in without your phone.
account.twofa_step1: Install an authenticator app on your phone.
account.twofa_step2: Scan the QR code or, on this phone, open the link:
account.twofa_qr: QR code for the authenticator app
account.twofa_step3: Enter the 6-digit code shown in the app.
account.twofa_status_off: Two-step verification: off (we recommend turning it on)
account.codes_intro: A recovery code lets you set a new password if you forget it, or sign in without your phone. Each works once. New codes replace the old ones.
account.email_changed_verify: Address changed. We sent a confirmation link to the new address.

storage.title: No tracking
storage.text: We do not use advertising or analytics cookies. Should we store your latest search results on this device so they work offline?

consent.watch: I explicitly consent to the processing of information about the service I am looking for (it may be health information) in order to send notifications. I can withdraw consent at any time by removing the watch.
consent.required: Tick the consent box to start watching.

codes.title: Save your recovery codes
codes.intro: If you forget your password or lose your phone, one of these codes will restore access to your account. Each works only once. Save them now: we won't show them again.
codes.where: Good places: a password manager, a printout at home, a note outside this phone.
codes.file_footer: Each code works once. Use it under “Forgot password” or when signing in without your phone.
codes.copy_failed: Couldn't copy. Download the file or write the codes down.

personal.login_needed: This feature is available after signing in. The account is free and optional.

report.title: How did the call go?
report.reached_no: No, nobody answered or the line was busy
report.outcome_same: The same as in the app ({date})
report.outcome_same_nodate: The same as in NFZ data
report.outcome_none: No date offered (no slots, list closed)
report.add_case: I booked it: add the visit to My cases
report.privacy: Others will only see aggregated counts, without your data.
report.need_outcome: Choose what date you were offered.
report.thanks: Thank you! Your report will help others.
report.summary_later: The offered date is usually {n} days later than in NFZ data
report.summary_earlier: The offered date is usually {n} days earlier than in NFZ data

health.title: Consent to store your cases
health.text: Cases, notes and phone reports reveal which specialist you're booking. That may be health information, so we store it only with your explicit consent. Only you can see it (others see only aggregated report counts). You can withdraw consent at any time: we'll then delete this data.
health.check: I consent to the storage of information about my health matters in order to use these features (Art. 9(2)(a) GDPR).
health.required: Tick the consent box to continue.
health.withdraw_text: We'll delete all your cases, notes and phone reports. Watches stay (they have a separate consent).
health.withdraw_confirm: Delete all cases, notes and reports?

cases.title: My cases
cases.intro: Referrals and visits in one place. We'll remind you the day before a visit if you turn on phone notifications.
cases.new_placeholder: e.g. cardiologist, referral from Dr Nowak
cases.empty: No cases yet. Add one above or with “Add to my cases” on a result.

notes.label: Private note for this clinic
notes.private: Only you can see it, e.g. “call after 7:30, phone booking only”.

push.title: Phone notifications
push.on: On for this device (devices with notifications: {n}).
push.off: Off. Turn on to get earlier-slot alerts and visit reminders without installing other apps.
push.disabled_server: Push notifications are disabled on this instance.
push.unsupported: This browser doesn't support push notifications.
push.ios_install: On iPhone, first install the app (Share → Add to Home Screen) and open it from the icon.

push.failed: Couldn't turn on notifications. Try again.
